[Pending Restart] - While in PvP Combat, Ice Barrier is 30% less effective when used with Mana Shield active (and vice versa). Ice Barrier and Mana are two independently strong spells, but when used in tandem the strength of the spells is exponentially stronger. This nerf is meant to target absorption stackings and to not nerf the individual use case of the spells, allowing them to keep their niche.
